what: Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, schema_kshot arm, on the 30 held-out freight waybills. An OPEN checkpoint an on-prem buyer could run, with NO adaptation -- the rival explanation for everything this project claims.
prompt_construction: the tenant's field list AND 1 demonstration(s). Addendum R's discriminator cell: short prompt, examples present.
timing_integrity: Per-batch wall clock is banked so a contaminated cost figure is visible in the artifact rather than only in a log. This box has four cores; anything else running on them inflates the mean. Where the mean and the median disagree materially, the run shared the machine and THE MEDIAN IS THE HONEST FIGURE -- the mean is inflated, which for a rival's arm is the direction that flatters this project.
cost_basis: $0.29/hour CPU instance, external list price quoted 2026-08-19; not a measurement. The same quote every cost row on this page uses.

paired_ours_minus_theirs.note: positive mean_delta means our adapted 0.5B scored higher on average; the sign test is the second statistic and can disagree with it.

scope: One rung (Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct), one corpus, thirty agent-authored documents, one seed, batch 1, CPU, greedy. It says nothing about rungs it did not run, and it does not license 'bigger models beat adaptation' any more than the reverse.
verification_level: PRIMARY -- raw model output is stored for every document, so a reader can re-score every one against the published gold.

metadata_correction_2026-08-25.why: scale_rung_arm.py recorded `args.k if args.mode == 'kshot' else 0`, so the schema_kshot arm banked 0 demonstrations while its prompt was built from train[:1] like any other k-shot arm. The MEASUREMENT is untouched -- same prompts, same outputs, same scores. Only the configuration label was wrong.
metadata_correction_2026-08-25.how_it_was_caught: mean_prompt_tokens is 401 here against 196 for the pure-schema arm on the same corpus. A prompt 205 tokens longer with allegedly zero demonstrations does not add up, and the discrepancy is visible inside this file.
metadata_correction_2026-08-25.why_it_mattered: Addendum R asks what ONE demonstration does to a schema prompt. An artifact reporting zero demonstrations answers a different question and inverts the conclusion: read as banked, this cell looks like a replication of the pure-schema arm rather than the discriminator it is.
metadata_correction_2026-08-25.the_fix: scripts/scale_rung_arm.py now records args.k for every mode except pure `schema`, so a re-run reproduces this value.
